video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画三国「华佗之死」（青囊不传），时间约 208 年，建安十三年前。地点与格局：三国 · 建安十三年前（约 208 年）。城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。。人物：华佗（沛国谯人，医者）、曹操（丞相）、吴普（华佗弟子）、狱吏（许昌狱中狱吏）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频跟着这个人：衣袖与冠带轻摆，或独坐、或对坐、或踏上远路，镜头缓推，保持同一剪影，不新增人物。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "华佗之死" (青囊不传) in the 三国 chapter, 约 208 年. Place and layout: Three Kingdoms (220–280), c. 208 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.. Figures: Hua Tuo, Cao Cao, Wu Pu, Yu Li. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video follows this one figure: sleeves and hat-strings stirring, sitting alone or facing another, or setting out on a road. A slow push. Keep the same silhouette. No new figures. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画三国「受禅台」（汉亡魏兴），时间220 年十月，东汉延康元年 / 曹魏黄初元年。地点与格局：三国 · 东汉延康元年 / 曹魏黄初元年（220 年十月）。城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。。人物：曹丕（魏王，后为魏文帝）、汉献帝（刘协）、曹节（献帝皇后，曹操之女）、华歆（御史大夫）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "受禅台" (汉亡魏兴) in the 三国 chapter, 220 年十月. Place and layout: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 220 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.. Figures: Cao Pi, Han Xiandi, Cao Jie, Hua Xin. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画三国「七擒孟获」（南中平定），时间225 年，蜀汉建兴三年。地点与格局：三国 · 蜀汉建兴三年（225 年）。城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。。人物：诸葛亮（丞相）、孟获（南中豪帅）、马谡（参军）、雍闿（益州郡豪强）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频跟着这个人：衣袖与冠带轻摆，或独坐、或对坐、或踏上远路，镜头缓推，保持同一剪影，不新增人物。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "七擒孟获" (南中平定) in the 三国 chapter, 225 年. Place and layout: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 225 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.. Figures: Zhuge Liang, Meng Huo, Ma Su, Yong Kai. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video follows this one figure: sleeves and hat-strings stirring, sitting alone or facing another, or setting out on a road. A slow push. Keep the same silhouette. No new figures. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画三国「此间乐」（乐不思蜀），时间264 年三月后，曹魏咸熙元年。地点与格局：三国 · 曹魏咸熙元年（264 年三月后）。城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。。人物：刘禅（蜀汉后主，安乐县公）、司马昭（晋王）、郤正（秘书令）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "此间乐" (乐不思蜀) in the 三国 chapter, 264 年三月后. Place and layout: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 264 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.. Figures: Liu Chan, Sima Zhao, Xi Zheng. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画三国「羊陆之交」（岂有鸩人羊叔子），时间约 272—274 年，西晋泰始八年至十年。地点与格局：三国 · 西晋泰始八年至十年（约 272—274 年）。城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。。人物：羊祜（晋车骑将军，都督荆州诸军事）、陆抗（吴镇军大将军）、孙皓（吴末帝）、杜预（镇南大将军）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频跟着这个人：衣袖与冠带轻摆，或独坐、或对坐、或踏上远路，镜头缓推，保持同一剪影，不新增人物。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "羊陆之交" (岂有鸩人羊叔子) in the 三国 chapter, 约 272—274 年. Place and layout: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 272 CE–274 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.. Figures: Yang Hu, Lu Kang, Sun Hao, Du Yu. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video follows this one figure: sleeves and hat-strings stirring, sitting alone or facing another, or setting out on a road. A slow push. Keep the same silhouette. No new figures. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画两晋「珊瑚碎」（石崇王恺斗富），时间太康年间（280—289 年）。地点与格局：两晋 · （太康年间（280—289 年））。江南园林、曲水、竹林、建康城。。人物：石崇（荆州刺史、卫尉）、王恺（后将军，武帝之舅）、司马炎（晋武帝）、傅咸（司隶校尉）、绿珠（石崇之妓）、孙秀（赵王伦之谋主）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。

Place and layout: Western and Eastern Jin (266–420), c. 285 CE — Jiangnan gardens, winding streams, bamboo groves, Jiankang city.. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画两晋「八王之乱」（骨肉相残），时间291—306 年，晋元康元年至光熙元年。地点与格局：两晋 · 晋元康元年至光熙元年（291—306 年）。江南园林、曲水、竹林、建康城。。人物：贾南风（皇后）、晋惠帝（司马衷）、赵王伦（司马伦）、楚王玮（司马玮）、孙秀（赵王伦谋主）、嵇绍（侍中，嵇康之子）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "八王之乱" (骨肉相残) in the 两晋 chapter, 291—306 年. Place and layout: Western and Eastern Jin (266–420), 291 CE–306 CE — Jiangnan gardens, winding streams, bamboo groves, Jiankang city.. Figures: Jia Nanfeng, Jin Huidi, Zhao Wanglun, Chu Wangwei, Sun Xiu, Ji Shao. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画两晋「永嘉之乱」（洛阳陷落），时间311 年，晋永嘉五年。地点与格局：两晋 · 晋永嘉五年（311 年）。江南园林、曲水、竹林、建康城。。人物：晋怀帝（司马炽）、刘聪（汉赵皇帝）、石勒（汉赵大将）、刘曜（汉赵大将）、王弥（汉赵将领）、王衍（太尉）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频跟着这个人：衣袖与冠带轻摆，或独坐、或对坐、或踏上远路，镜头缓推，保持同一剪影，不新增人物。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "永嘉之乱" (洛阳陷落) in the 两晋 chapter, 311 年. Place and layout: Western and Eastern Jin (266–420), 311 CE — Jiangnan gardens, winding streams, bamboo groves, Jiankang city.. Figures: Jin Huaidi, Liu Cong, Shi Lei, Liu Yao, Wang Mi, Wang Yan. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video follows this one figure: sleeves and hat-strings stirring, sitting alone or facing another, or setting out on a road. A slow push. Keep the same silhouette. No new figures. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画两晋「兰亭」（永和九年），时间353 年三月三日，东晋永和九年暮春之初。地点与格局：两晋 · 东晋永和九年暮春之初（353 年三月三日）。江南园林、曲水、竹林、建康城。。人物：王羲之（右军将军、会稽内史）、谢安（东山隐士）、孙绰（散骑常侍）、王献之（王羲之之子）、辩才（永欣寺僧）、萧翼（唐监察御史）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "兰亭" (永和九年) in the 两晋 chapter, 353 年三月三日. Place and layout: Western and Eastern Jin (266–420), 353 CE — Jiangnan gardens, winding streams, bamboo groves, Jiankang city.. Figures: Wang Xizhi, Xie An, Sun Chuo, Wang Xianzhi, Bian Cai, Xiao Yi. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画两晋「咏絮之才」（谢道韫），时间399 年，东晋隆安三年。地点与格局：两晋 · 东晋隆安三年（399 年）。江南园林、曲水、竹林、建康城。。人物：谢道韫（谢奕之女，王凝之之妻）、谢安（道韫之叔，太傅）、谢朗（道韫从兄，小字胡儿）、王凝之（王羲之之子，会稽内史）、孙恩（五斗米道首领）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "咏絮之才" (谢道韫) in the 两晋 chapter, 399 年. Place and layout: Western and Eastern Jin (266–420), 399 CE — Jiangnan gardens, winding streams, bamboo groves, Jiankang city.. Figures: Xie Daoyun, Xie An, Xie Lang, Wang Ningzhi, Sun En. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画两晋「归去来」（陶渊明），时间405 年十一月，东晋义熙元年十一月。地点与格局：两晋 · 东晋义熙元年十一月（405 年十一月）。江南园林、曲水、竹林、建康城。。人物：陶渊明（陶潜，元亮）、督邮（郡吏）、武陵渔人（《桃花源记》中的人物）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频跟着这个人：衣袖与冠带轻摆，或独坐、或对坐、或踏上远路，镜头缓推，保持同一剪影，不新增人物。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "归去来" (陶渊明) in the 两晋 chapter, 405 年十一月. Place and layout: Western and Eastern Jin (266–420), 405 CE — Jiangnan gardens, winding streams, bamboo groves, Jiankang city.. Figures: Tao Yuanming, Du You, Wu Lingyuren. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video follows this one figure: sleeves and hat-strings stirring, sitting alone or facing another, or setting out on a road. A slow push. Keep the same silhouette. No new figures. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画南北朝「国史之狱」（崔浩），时间450 年六月，北魏太武帝太平真君十一年。地点与格局：南北朝 · 北魏太武帝太平真君十一年（450 年六月）。佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞。。人物：崔浩（司徒，监秘书事）、拓跋焘（北魏太武帝）、高允（中书侍郎，参著国史）、拓跋晃（太子，总百揆）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "国史之狱" (崔浩) in the 南北朝 chapter, 450 年六月. Place and layout: Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589), 450 CE — Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts.. Figures: Cui Hao, Tuoba Dao, Gao Yun, Tuoba Huang. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画南北朝「大明历」（祖冲之），时间462 年，宋大明六年。地点与格局：南北朝 · 宋大明六年（462 年）。佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞。。人物：祖冲之（南徐州从事、娄县令）、戴法兴（中书舍人）、刘骏（宋孝武帝）、索驭驎（北人）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频跟着这个人：衣袖与冠带轻摆，或独坐、或对坐、或踏上远路，镜头缓推，保持同一剪影，不新增人物。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "大明历" (祖冲之) in the 南北朝 chapter, 462 年. Place and layout: Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589), 462 CE — Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts.. Figures: Zu Chongzhi, Dai Faxing, Liu Jun, Suo Yulin. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video follows this one figure: sleeves and hat-strings stirring, sitting alone or facing another, or setting out on a road. A slow push. Keep the same silhouette. No new figures. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画南北朝「迁都洛阳」（北魏孝文帝），时间493—496 年，北魏太和十七年至二十年。地点与格局：南北朝 · 北魏太和十七年至二十年（493—496 年）。佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞。。人物：北魏孝文帝（拓跋宏（元宏））、李冲（尚书）、拓跋恂（太子）、鲜卑旧臣（代北贵族）、冯太后（文明太后）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "迁都洛阳" (北魏孝文帝) in the 南北朝 chapter, 493—496 年. Place and layout: Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589), 493 CE–496 CE — Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts.. Figures: Bei Weixiaowendi, Li Chong, Tuoba Xun, Xian Beijiuchen, Empress Dowager Feng. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画南北朝「舍身同泰寺」（梁武帝与达摩），时间527 年三月，梁大通元年。地点与格局：南北朝 · 梁大通元年（527 年三月）。佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞。。人物：萧衍（梁武帝）、菩提达摩（西域沙门）、神光（慧可）（达摩弟子）、群臣（梁朝百官）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "舍身同泰寺" (梁武帝与达摩) in the 南北朝 chapter, 527 年三月. Place and layout: Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589), 527 CE — Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts.. Figures: Xiao Yan, Bodhidharma, Shen Guang, Qun Chen. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is this person's leitmotif: a short phrase on one instrument, repeated, only growing or thinning with the life, lots of rest, pentatonic, no lyrics. This cue: "舍身同泰寺" in 南北朝.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画南北朝「水经注」（郦道元之死），时间527 年，北魏孝明帝孝昌三年。地点与格局：南北朝 · 北魏孝明帝孝昌三年（527 年）。佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞。。人物：郦道元（御史中尉，后为关右大使）、萧宝夤（雍州刺史，南齐宗室）、元悦（汝南王）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频跟着这个人：衣袖与冠带轻摆，或独坐、或对坐、或踏上远路，镜头缓推，保持同一剪影，不新增人物。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "水经注" (郦道元之死) in the 南北朝 chapter, 527 年. Place and layout: Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589), 527 CE — Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts.. Figures: Li Daoyuan, Xiao Baoyin, Yuan Yue. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video follows this one figure: sleeves and hat-strings stirring, sitting alone or facing another, or setting out on a road. A slow push. Keep the same silhouette. No new figures. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画隋「仁寿宫」（杨广夺嫡），时间600—604 年，隋开皇二十年至仁寿四年。地点与格局：隋 · 隋开皇二十年至仁寿四年（600—604 年）。大兴城、运河龙舟、宫殿斗拱。。人物：杨广（晋王，后为皇太子、隋炀帝）、杨勇（皇太子）、杨坚（隋文帝）、独孤皇后（文献皇后）、杨素（尚书左仆射）、陈夫人（宣华夫人）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "仁寿宫" (杨广夺嫡) in the 隋 chapter, 600—604 年. Place and layout: Sui dynasty (581–618), 600 CE–604 CE — Daxing city, the Grand Canal and dragon boats, bracketed palace halls.. Figures: Yang Guang, Yang Yong, Yang Jian, Empress Dugu, Yang Su, Lady Chen. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画隋「自锁上变」（李靖与红拂），时间617 年，隋大业十三年。地点与格局：隋 · 隋大业十三年（617 年）。大兴城、运河龙舟、宫殿斗拱。。人物：李靖（马邑郡丞）、李渊（太原留守，后为唐高祖）、李世民（秦王）、红拂女（杨素府中执拂侍女（传奇人物））、虬髯客（张仲坚（传奇人物））。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "自锁上变" (李靖与红拂) in the 隋 chapter, 617 年. Place and layout: Sui dynasty (581–618), 617 CE — Daxing city, the Grand Canal and dragon boats, bracketed palace halls.. Figures: Li Jing, Li Yuan, Li Shimin, Hong Funü, Qiu Ranke. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画隋「江都之变」（好头颈），时间618 年三月，隋大业十四年三月。地点与格局：隋 · 隋大业十四年三月（618 年三月）。大兴城、运河龙舟、宫殿斗拱。。人物：杨广（隋炀帝）、萧皇后（炀帝之后）、宇文化及（右屯卫将军）、司马德戡（虎贲郎将）、虞世基（内史侍郎）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频跟着这个人：衣袖与冠带轻摆，或独坐、或对坐、或踏上远路，镜头缓推，保持同一剪影，不新增人物。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "江都之变" (好头颈) in the 隋 chapter, 618 年三月. Place and layout: Sui dynasty (581–618), 618 CE — Daxing city, the Grand Canal and dragon boats, bracketed palace halls.. Figures: Yang Guang, Empress Xiao, Yuwen Huaji, Sima Dekan, Yu Shiji. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video follows this one figure: sleeves and hat-strings stirring, sitting alone or facing another, or setting out on a road. A slow push. Keep the same silhouette. No new figures. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画唐「文成公主入藏」（唐蕃和亲），时间641 年正月，唐贞观十五年正月。地点与格局：唐 · 唐贞观十五年正月（641 年正月）。长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。。人物：文成公主（宗室女）、松赞干布（弃宗弄赞，吐蕃赞普）、禄东赞（吐蕃大论）、李道宗（江夏王）、唐太宗（李世民）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "文成公主入藏" (唐蕃和亲) in the 唐 chapter, 641 年正月. Place and layout: Tang dynasty (618–907), 641 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.. Figures: Princess Wencheng, Songtsen Gampo, Gar Tongtsen, Li Daozong, Tang Taizong. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画唐「以人为镜」（魏征），时间643 年正月，贞观十七年。地点与格局：唐 · 贞观十七年（643 年正月）。长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。。人物：魏征（谏议大夫、侍中，封郑国公）、唐太宗（李世民）、长孙皇后（太宗皇后）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "以人为镜" (魏征) in the 唐 chapter, 643 年正月. Place and layout: Tang dynasty (618–907), 643 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.. Figures: Wei Zheng, Tang Taizong, Empress Zhangsun. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画唐「落霞孤鹜」（滕王阁序），时间675 年九月，唐高宗上元二年。地点与格局：唐 · 唐高宗上元二年（675 年九月）。长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。。人物：王勃（初唐四杰之一）、阎都督（洪州都督（《唐摭言》称阎公））、阎公之婿（阎公女婿（《唐摭言》作吴子章））。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频跟着这个人：衣袖与冠带轻摆，或独坐、或对坐、或踏上远路，镜头缓推，保持同一剪影，不新增人物。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "落霞孤鹜" (滕王阁序) in the 唐 chapter, 675 年九月. Place and layout: Tang dynasty (618–907), c. 675 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.. Figures: Wang Bo, Yan Dudu, Yan Gongzhixu. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video follows this one figure: sleeves and hat-strings stirring, sitting alone or facing another, or setting out on a road. A slow push. Keep the same silhouette. No new figures. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画唐「无字碑」（武则天），时间690—705 年，武周天授元年至神龙元年。地点与格局：唐 · 武周天授元年至神龙元年（690—705 年）。长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。。人物：武则天（武曌，圣神皇帝）、狄仁杰（宰相）、上官婉儿（掌制诰）、张柬之（宰相）、李显（庐陵王，后之唐中宗）、张易之（宠臣）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "无字碑" (武则天) in the 唐 chapter, 690—705 年. Place and layout: Tang dynasty (618–907), 690 CE–705 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.. Figures: Wu Zetian, Di Renjie, Shangguan Waner, Zhang Jianzhi, Li Xian, Zhang Yizhi. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画唐「帛书鸣冤」（狄仁杰），时间692 年正月，武周长寿元年。地点与格局：唐 · 武周长寿元年（692 年正月）。长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。。人物：狄仁杰（地官侍郎、同平章事）、来俊臣（酷吏）、狄光远（狄仁杰之子）、武则天（圣神皇帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "帛书鸣冤" (狄仁杰) in the 唐 chapter, 692 年正月. Place and layout: Tang dynasty (618–907), 692 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.. Figures: Di Renjie, Lai Junchen, Di Guangyuan, Wu Zetian. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画唐「称量天下」（上官婉儿），时间709 年正月晦日，唐中宗景龙三年。地点与格局：唐 · 唐中宗景龙三年（709 年正月晦日）。长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。。人物：上官婉儿（昭容，上官仪孙女）、唐中宗（李显）、宋之问（考功员外郎）、沈佺期（起居郎）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频跟着这个人：衣袖与冠带轻摆，或独坐、或对坐、或踏上远路，镜头缓推，保持同一剪影，不新增人物。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "称量天下" (上官婉儿) in the 唐 chapter, 709 年正月晦日. Place and layout: Tang dynasty (618–907), 709 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.. Figures: Shangguan Waner, Tang Zhongzong, Song Zhiwen, Shen Quanqi. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video follows this one figure: sleeves and hat-strings stirring, sitting alone or facing another, or setting out on a road. A slow push. Keep the same silhouette. No new figures. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画唐「谪仙人」（李白在长安），时间742—744 年，唐玄宗天宝元年至三载。地点与格局：唐 · 唐玄宗天宝元年至三载（742—744 年）。长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。。人物：李白（翰林供奉）、贺知章（太子宾客）、高力士（骠骑大将军）、杨贵妃（玄宗贵妃）、唐玄宗（李隆基）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "谪仙人" (李白在长安) in the 唐 chapter, 742—744 年. Place and layout: Tang dynasty (618–907), 742 CE–744 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.. Figures: Li Bai, He Zhizhang, Gao Lishi, Yang Guifei, Tang Xuanzong. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画唐「渔阳鼙鼓」（安史之乱与马嵬），时间755—756 年，唐天宝十四载至十五载。地点与格局：唐 · 唐天宝十四载至十五载（755—756 年）。长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。。人物：唐玄宗（李隆基）、杨贵妃（杨玉环）、安禄山（范阳、平卢、河东节度使）、杨国忠（宰相）、陈玄礼（龙武大将军）、高力士（宦官）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "渔阳鼙鼓" (安史之乱与马嵬) in the 唐 chapter, 755—756 年. Place and layout: Tang dynasty (618–907), 755 CE–756 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.. Figures: Tang Xuanzong, Yang Guifei, An Lushan, Yang Guozhong, Chen Xuanli, Gao Lishi. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画唐「石壕夜捉人」（杜甫），时间759 年春，唐肃宗乾元二年。地点与格局：唐 · 唐肃宗乾元二年（759 年春）。长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。。人物：杜甫（华州司功参军）、老妇（石壕村老妇）、老翁（石壕村老翁）、差吏（石壕村差吏）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频跟着这个人：衣袖与冠带轻摆，或独坐、或对坐、或踏上远路，镜头缓推，保持同一剪影，不新增人物。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "石壕夜捉人" (杜甫) in the 唐 chapter, 759 年春. Place and layout: Tang dynasty (618–907), 759 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.. Figures: Du Fu, Lao Fu, Lao Weng, Cha Li. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video follows this one figure: sleeves and hat-strings stirring, sitting alone or facing another, or setting out on a road. A slow push. Keep the same silhouette. No new figures. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画唐「红线盗盒」（魏博与昭义），时间约 770 年前后，唐代宗大历初。地点与格局：唐 · 唐代宗大历初（约 770 年前后）。长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。。人物：红线（潞州节度使薛嵩的侍女（传奇人物））、薛嵩（昭义（潞州）节度使）、田承嗣（魏博节度使）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "红线盗盒" (魏博与昭义) in the 唐 chapter, 约 770 年前后. Place and layout: Tang dynasty (618–907), c. 770 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.. Figures: Hong Xian, Xue Song, Tian Chengsi. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画唐「祭侄文稿」（颜真卿），时间784 年八月，唐德宗兴元元年。地点与格局：唐 · 唐德宗兴元元年（784 年八月）。长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。。人物：颜真卿（太子太师，鲁郡公）、颜杲卿（常山太守，颜真卿从兄）、颜季明（颜杲卿之子）、李希烈（淮西节度使，僭号称帝）、卢杞（宰相）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "祭侄文稿" (颜真卿) in the 唐 chapter, 784 年八月. Place and layout: Tang dynasty (618–907), 784 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.. Figures: Yan Zhenqing, Yan Gaoqing, Yan Jiming, Li Xilie, Lu Qi. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画唐「浔阳琵琶」（白居易），时间816 年秋，唐宪宗元和十一年。地点与格局：唐 · 唐宪宗元和十一年（816 年秋）。长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。。人物：白居易（江州司马）、琵琶女（长安倡女，商人之妇）、武元衡（宰相）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频跟着这个人：衣袖与冠带轻摆，或独坐、或对坐、或踏上远路，镜头缓推，保持同一剪影，不新增人物。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "浔阳琵琶" (白居易) in the 唐 chapter, 816 年秋. Place and layout: Tang dynasty (618–907), c. 816 CE — Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.. Figures: Bai Juyi, Pi Panü, Wu Yuanheng. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video follows this one figure: sleeves and hat-strings stirring, sitting alone or facing another, or setting out on a road. A slow push. Keep the same silhouette. No new figures. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画唐「会昌毁佛」（圆仁亲见），时间845 年八月，唐武宗会昌五年。地点与格局：唐 · 唐武宗会昌五年（845 年八月）。长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。。人物：唐武宗（李炎）、赵归真（道士）、圆仁（日本入唐求法僧）、李德裕（宰相）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。

Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画五代十国「白马驿」（朱温篡唐），时间905—907 年，唐天祐二年至后梁开平元年。地点与格局：五代十国 · 唐天祐二年至后梁开平元年（905—907 年）。汴梁与金陵、江南园林、军镇。。人物：朱温（朱全忠，梁太祖）、李振（朱温幕僚）、裴枢（唐宰相）、朱全昱（朱温之兄）、李柷（唐哀帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "白马驿" (朱温篡唐) in the 五代十国 chapter, 905—907 年. Place and layout: Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms (907–979), 905 CE–907 CE — Bianliang and Jinling, Jiangnan gardens, military garrisons.. Figures: Zhu Wen, Li Zhen, Pei Shu, Zhu Quanyu, Li Chu. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画五代十国「燕云」（石敬瑭），时间936—938 年，后唐清泰三年至后晋天福三年。地点与格局：五代十国 · 后唐清泰三年至后晋天福三年（936—938 年）。汴梁与金陵、江南园林、军镇。。人物：石敬瑭（河东节度使，后晋高祖）、耶律德光（契丹皇帝）、桑维翰（掌书记）、刘知远（都押衙）、李从珂（后唐末帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频跟着这个人：衣袖与冠带轻摆，或独坐、或对坐、或踏上远路，镜头缓推，保持同一剪影，不新增人物。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

Image-to-video follows this one figure: sleeves and hat-strings stirring, sitting alone or facing another, or setting out on a road. A slow push. Keep the same silhouette. No new figures. image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画五代十国「春花秋月」（李煜），时间961—978 年，南唐建隆二年至宋太平兴国三年。地点与格局：五代十国 · 南唐建隆二年至宋太平兴国三年（961—978 年）。汴梁与金陵、江南园林、军镇。。人物：李煜（南唐后主）、小周后（周氏）、宋太祖（赵匡胤）、曹彬（宋将）、樊若水（南唐落第士人）、徐铉（南唐旧臣）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "春花秋月" (李煜) in the 五代十国 chapter, 961—978 年. Place and layout: Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms (907–979), 961 CE–978 CE — Bianliang and Jinling, Jiangnan gardens, military garrisons.. Figures: Li Yu, Xiao Zhouhou, Song Taizu, Cao Bin, Fan Ruoshui, Xu Xuan. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is this person's leitmotif: a short phrase on one instrument, repeated, only growing or thinning with the life, lots of rest, pentatonic, no lyrics. This cue: "春花秋月" in 五代十国.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画五代十国「夜宴」（韩熙载），时间约 965—970 年，南唐后主时期。地点与格局：五代十国 · 南唐后主时期（约 965—970 年）。汴梁与金陵、江南园林、军镇。。人物：韩熙载（南唐中书侍郎）、李煜（南唐后主）、顾闳中（南唐画院待诏）、王屋山（韩府舞伎）、李穀（后周宰相）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频跟着这个人：衣袖与冠带轻摆，或独坐、或对坐、或踏上远路，镜头缓推，保持同一剪影，不新增人物。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "夜宴" (韩熙载) in the 五代十国 chapter, 约 965—970 年. Place and layout: Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms (907–979), 965 CE–970 CE — Bianliang and Jinling, Jiangnan gardens, military garrisons.. Figures: Han Xizai, Li Yu, Gu Hongzhong, Wang Wushan, Li Gu. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video follows this one figure: sleeves and hat-strings stirring, sitting alone or facing another, or setting out on a road. A slow push. Keep the same silhouette. No new figures. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画北宋「烛影斧声」（太祖之死），时间976 年十一月，宋太祖开宝九年。地点与格局：北宋 · 宋太祖开宝九年（976 年十一月）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。。人物：赵匡胤（宋太祖）、赵光义（晋王，后为宋太宗）、宋皇后（太祖皇后）、王继恩（内侍都知）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。

Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画北宋「陈家谷」（杨业），时间986 年，雍熙三年。地点与格局：北宋 · 雍熙三年（986 年）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。。人物：杨业（云州观察使）、潘美（云应路行营都部署）、王侁（监军）、刘文裕（军器库使）、杨延玉（杨业之子）、耶律斜轸（辽将）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "陈家谷" (杨业) in the 北宋 chapter, 986 年. Place and layout: Northern Song (960–1127), 986 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.. Figures: Yang Ye, Pan Mei, Wang Shen, Liu Wenyu, Yang Yanyu, Yelü Xiezhen. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画北宋「狸猫换太子」（刘太后与李宸妃），时间1032 年，宋仁宗明道元年。地点与格局：北宋 · 宋仁宗明道元年（1032 年）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。。人物：刘娥（章献明肃皇后，仁宗嫡母）、李宸妃（仁宗生母）、宋仁宗（赵祯）、吕夷简（宰相）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频跟着这个人：衣袖与冠带轻摆，或独坐、或对坐、或踏上远路，镜头缓推，保持同一剪影，不新增人物。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "狸猫换太子" (刘太后与李宸妃) in the 北宋 chapter, 1032 年. Place and layout: Northern Song (960–1127), 1032 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.. Figures: Liu E, Li Chenfei, Song Renzong, Lü Yijian. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video follows this one figure: sleeves and hat-strings stirring, sitting alone or facing another, or setting out on a road. A slow push. Keep the same silhouette. No new figures. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画北宋「千年一榜」（欧阳修知贡举），时间1057 年，宋仁宗嘉祐二年。地点与格局：北宋 · 宋仁宗嘉祐二年（1057 年）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。。人物：欧阳修（翰林学士，知贡举）、梅尧臣（点检试卷官）、苏轼（眉山举子）、苏辙（苏轼之弟）、曾巩（南丰举子）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "千年一榜" (欧阳修知贡举) in the 北宋 chapter, 1057 年. Place and layout: Northern Song (960–1127), 1057 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.. Figures: Ouyang Xiu, Mei Yaochen, Su Shi, Su Zhe, Zeng Gong. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画北宋「熙宁变法」（王安石），时间1069—1085 年，宋熙宁二年至元丰八年。地点与格局：北宋 · 宋熙宁二年至元丰八年（1069—1085 年）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。。人物：王安石（参知政事，后为宰相）、宋神宗（赵顼）、司马光（翰林学士）、吕惠卿（变法派）、郑侠（监安上门）、苏轼（文臣）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频跟着这个人：衣袖与冠带轻摆，或独坐、或对坐、或踏上远路，镜头缓推，保持同一剪影，不新增人物。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "熙宁变法" (王安石) in the 北宋 chapter, 1069—1085 年. Place and layout: Northern Song (960–1127), 1069 CE–1085 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.. Figures: Wang Anshi, Song Shenzong, Sima Guang, Lü Huiqing, Zheng Xia, Su Shi. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video follows this one figure: sleeves and hat-strings stirring, sitting alone or facing another, or setting out on a road. A slow push. Keep the same silhouette. No new figures. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画北宋「乌台诗案」（苏轼），时间1079 年七月至十二月，宋元丰二年。地点与格局：北宋 · 宋元丰二年（1079 年七月至十二月）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。。人物：苏轼（湖州知州）、苏迈（苏轼长子）、苏辙（苏轼之弟）、李定（御史中丞）、赵顼（宋神宗）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "乌台诗案" (苏轼) in the 北宋 chapter, 1079 年七月至十二月. Place and layout: Northern Song (960–1127), 1079 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.. Figures: Su Shi, Su Mai, Su Zhe, Li Ding, Zhao Xu. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画北宋「臣之精力」（司马光与资治通鉴），时间1084 年十二月，宋神宗元丰七年。地点与格局：北宋 · 宋神宗元丰七年（1084 年十二月）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。。人物：司马光（端明殿学士，判西京御史台）、刘恕（编修官）、范祖禹（编修官）、王安石（前宰相）、刘攽（编修官）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "臣之精力" (司马光与资治通鉴) in the 北宋 chapter, 1084 年十二月. Place and layout: Northern Song (960–1127), 1084 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.. Figures: Sima Guang, Liu Shu, Fan Zuyu, Wang Anshi, Liu Ban. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画北宋「帮源洞」（方腊与宋江），时间1121 年四月，宣和三年四月。地点与格局：北宋 · 宣和三年四月（1121 年四月）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。。人物：方腊（起事首领）、童贯（江淮荆浙宣抚使）、韩世忠（偏将）、宋江（起事首领）、张叔夜（知海州）、辛兴宗（将领）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频跟着这个人：衣袖与冠带轻摆，或独坐、或对坐、或踏上远路，镜头缓推，保持同一剪影，不新增人物。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "帮源洞" (方腊与宋江) in the 北宋 chapter, 1121 年四月. Place and layout: Northern Song (960–1127), 1121 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.. Figures: Fang La, Tong Guan, Han Shizhong, Song Jiang, Zhang Shuye, Xin Xingzong. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video follows this one figure: sleeves and hat-strings stirring, sitting alone or facing another, or setting out on a road. A slow push. Keep the same silhouette. No new figures. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画辽 · 西夏 · 金「十香词」（萧观音），时间1075 年十一月，辽道宗大康元年。地点与格局：辽 · 西夏 · 金 · 辽道宗大康元年（1075 年十一月）。草原毡帐、捺钵营地、城塞、雪原。。人物：萧观音（辽道宗宣懿皇后）、辽道宗（耶律洪基）、耶律乙辛（北院枢密使）、赵惟一（伶官）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "十香词" (萧观音) in the 辽 · 西夏 · 金 chapter, 1075 年十一月. Place and layout: Liao, Western Xia and Jin (907–1234), 1075 CE — steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields.. Figures: Xiao Guanyin, Liao Daozong, Yelü Yixin, Zhao Weiyi. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.
